thread:
Alex Chen: Heads up — we need final numbers for BlueHarbor Q3 dedicated capacity. Sales wants a signed commit by EOD Tue. They asked for '8 A100 equiv running 24/7' and requested a 15% safety buffer. Can infra confirm GPU-hours, expected throughput headroom, and any region caveats?
Maria Gonzalez: Quick snapshot: 8 gpus 24/7 -> baseline = 8 * 24 * 30 = 5760 GPU-hours/mo. With 15% buffer that's ~6624 GPU-hours/mo.
Maria Gonzalez: Important: their traffic is bursty M-F 09:00-18:00 UTC, peaks ~2.2x baseline during product demos. Seasonal uplift estimated +20% in Sept (marketing campaign).
Samir Patel: Question — BlueHarbor prefers APAC presence. We have limited spare A100 capacity in APAC in Sept. If we place dedicated pool in us-west and enable cross-region burst, latency for some flows will jump ~80-120ms. Is that acceptable to sales? :thinking:
Tess: Also flagging cluster health history — last month's rolling maintenance caused 6% effective capacity loss for 12h across the pool. I recommend adding an ops safety margin for maintenance and live-disk replacements. That suggests pushing buffer to ~18% in worst case.
Maria Gonzalez: Agreed. Updated calc including maintenance margin: baseline 5760 * (1 + 0.15 buffer + 0.03 maintenance) = 5760 * 1.18 = 6797 GPU-hours. If we also include expected Sept uplift (+20%) for Q3 projections only, that pushes monthly to ~8156 for Sept.
Alex Chen: Sales is pushing back on higher numbers. They offered a 12-month committed discount if we can sign at 7k GPU-hours/mo. Can infra support 7k with auto-burst to spare capacity and a fallback policy to open-hosted for overflow?
Samir Patel: Technically yes — we can commit 7k in dedicated pool in us-west and configure smart routing for APAC requests: route APAC to nearest available pool, fall back to hosted API (with latency-aware decision). Need to confirm SLO changes and customer consent for cross-region fallback.
Tess: Operationally, if we accept 7k commit we should lock a 10% maintenance reserve and enable scheduled rolling updates outside the customer's peak windows. Also add a cluster health alert threshold at 85% utilization to trigger automatic preemptive provisioning.
infra-bot: [capacity-metrics] Projection job run: repo: ci/capacity/blueharbor-q3; baseline_hours=5760; buffer=15%; maintenance=3%; seasonal_uplift=20%; computed_monthly_caps=[5760, 6624, 6797, 8156] — link: https://ci.internal/capacity/1773456789/report
Maria Gonzalez: If sales signs for 7k we need contractual language: allowed bursting to hosted endpoints, fallback latency SLA exemptions, and a cap on monthly overage billing. I can draft the approval clauses.
Alex Chen: Okay plan: propose 7k/mo commit, include hosted overflow fallback + explicit APAC latency exemption + automatic scale triggers at 85% util. Maria to draft contract clauses, Samir to confirm cross-region routing config, Tess to set alerting and maintenance windows. Can everyone ack so I can share with Sales? :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Ack — will validate routing and compute the expected extra egress/cross-region cost by EOD.
Tess: Ack — I'll add runbooks and set the 85% alert.
Maria Gonzalez: Ack — drafting contract now, will add the monthly overage cap and notification cadence.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. I'll feed this back to Sales and ask BlueHarbor to accept the APAC fallback. If they refuse APAC fallback, we need to re-run sizing with full APAC capacity, which will increase price ~+28%.
